historical_significance: Movement of Indigo Planters (1917) - First Satyagraha by Mahatma Gandhi in India
Peasant Satyagraha (1917) for revenue remission due to crop failure
Cotton Mill Workers Satyagraha (1918) for plague bonus
Jallianwala Bagh Massacre on 13 April 1919 by General Dyer
Police station set on fire in Feb 1922; prompted Gandhi to withdraw Non-Cooperation Movement
Culmination of Salt March on 6 April 1930, launching Civil Disobedience Movement
Special Congress Session where Non-Cooperation resolution was mooted
Annual Congress Session where Non-Cooperation program was formally adopted
INC Session presided by Dr. M.A. Ansari, resolved to boycott Simon Commission
INC Session under Jawaharlal Nehru declaring Purna Swaraj (Complete Independence)
